title: JUAC/FCTA staff protest continues through 2 July

start_date.summary: Punch reports the protest began June 30.

end_date.summary: Punch reports a three-day action ending July 2.

demands.summary: Reported grievances included unpaid salaries, teachers’ strike and staff welfare.

scope_note: Onset predates July; retained as a continuation, not a July-start candidate. No attendance count.
